hooks.command: bash -lc 'input=$(cat); root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude}"; if [ -f "$root/scripts/hooks/run-with-flags.js" ]; then printf "%s" "$input" | node "$root/scripts/hooks/run-with-flags.js" "session:start" "scripts/hooks/session-start.js" "minimal,standard"; exit $?; fi; if [ -f "$HOME/.claude/scripts/hooks/session-start.js" ]; then printf "%s" "$input" | node "$HOME/.claude/scripts/hooks/session-start.js"; exit $?; fi; printf "%s" "$input"; exit 0'
